methodology.area_units: Mapped Liberty cell areas in µm²; sequential area sums cells with ff/latch groups.
methodology.time_units: Native STA delay converted using report_units Time scale; normalized CSV columns use s and ns.
methodology.power_units: OpenSTA report_power prints watts directly; report_units leakage-power factor is not applied.
methodology.performance_per_watt_note: Conventional throughput/W = 1/(T*P). The handout's literal T/P is reported separately.
methodology.energy_note: Energy/op = P*T at critical-delay operation rate; VCD power is tied to the testbench's measured workload.
methodology.timing_paths_note: Three slowest distinct start/end pairs come from per-source enumeration. occurrences_same_pair counts appearances in the original globally ranked report; zero means the pair was absent from that truncated report.
methodology.csv_note: Project-defined CSV headers; the official CSV-template requirement was deleted.
